Scales 1-3 reduce integrally to expected free chain generators. Every critical cycle is lifted through the recorded chain homotopy equivalences; the scale-one-to-two degree-one inclusion has determinant -1 and the scale-three-to-four degree-three inclusion is the zero integer 1-by-6 matrix. Unique antipodal distance-six partners yield \(K_5\cong S^{11}\) and \(K_6\) contractible. A separate mod-two persistent boundary reduction corroborates the barcode without being used as an integer proof. The verifier uses actual embedded paths and exact arithmetic.

value.rationale: Determining the integral persistent homology of a canonical Archimedean graph is a naturally motivated classification: its previously uncomputed fourth-radius stage has nonzero homology in two separated degrees, and the complete inclusion maps show that one scale-four three-dimensional class is newly born rather than a surviving class from the six known scale-three generators. The unimodular degree-one inclusion is an integral, not simply rational, persistence statement. This adds structural information beyond a known single-scale sphere wedge, without claiming general or equivariant consequences.
